message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on facts. The case: construction without permit, no safety supervision, unqualified personnel, high formwork collapse causing death. This is a serious accident due to violation of safety regulations. In Chinese criminal law, this would be "以危险方法危害公共安全罪" (dangerous method endangering public safety) or "重大责任事故罪" (major responsibility accident). The examples: For dangerous construction leading to death, they used "重大责任事故" for cases like forklift accident, high fall, etc. Also "危险物品肇事" used for explosion. For construction safety violations causing death, the appropriate charge is "重大责任事故罪" (major responsibility accident). Also possibly "以危险方法危害公共安全罪" (dangerous method endangering public safety). In examples: The case with explosion (dangerous items) used "危险物品肇事". The case with forklift accident used "重大责任事故". The case with high fall from construction site used "重大责任事故". So here similar: high formwork collapse due to unsafe construction. So charge: 重大责任事故. Also maybe "非法行医"? No. Also "妨害公务"? No. So single charge: 重大责任事故.

Check if any other charge like "非法经营"? No. So answer: [罪名]重大责任事故<eoa>
